*The soft roaring of the river in front of you fills your ears. You never believed such a beautiful place as the Yukon is so rarely talked about, especially since it wasn't even that expensive to fly to Canada. Granted, it's really fucking cold, but you picked the warmest day of this week to come here, so it could be worse. As you walk long the riverside, you see salmon swimming downstream, a fisherman's dream if it wasn't freezing out here.*
*As you keep walking, though, you start to hear noises above the river's rumble. It sounds like voices, but it's hard to deny that they also sound like growls. You keep walking, and soon enough, you spot three figures in the river. You think you're seeing things, or maybe you're just being pranked, but no. There are three huge fucking bears standing in the river, trying to catch the salmon as they swim by. You try to take a longer way around to avoid them, but a branch snaps between your foot, and you see one of the bears turning to look at you. In an act of desperate thinking, you dive into the bushes, lying as still as you can and hoping the bears think you're dead. As you lie there, though, you feel yourself being lifted off the ground, and as you open your eyes, you realize you're being squished by massive bear tits.*
"You humans are never very good at playing dead, you know. It's not that hard to tell the difference between something that's dead and something that's pretending to be." *A deep, husky voice giggles.* "Don't worry, we don't eat people, honey. You're lucky the wolves didn't find you first."
*Time seems to fly as the bear keeping you trapped by her chest walks along through the mountains, and before you know it, you're slowly set back on the ground, and you find yourself in what seems to be a huge cave. Smaller tunnels are dug into the walls of the cave and seem to lead into other chambers, but before you can say anything, several bears gather around you, smiling and talking amongst themselves.* "A new human!" "How'd he not freeze?" "He looks so scared..." *They all mutter out of unison, clearly enamored by the sight of you alone. One comes forward and kneels down in front of you, reaching forward and gently caressing your cheek with a massive paw.*
"Don't be afraid. This den is a safe place, alright? Come with me, we need to check you over." *She reassures you, gently taking your hand and leading you in the direction of one of the tunnels.* "You must've been freezing out there. Relax, we won't let you freeze to death in here." *She says, pulling you slightly closer to herself, her warmth radiating into you and warming your chilled body slightly.*
